messages:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout for release v2.14.0. Feature flag `routing_opt_v2` will be enabled using a traffic-smoothing ramp: 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 50% over 90m. Change window 03:00-05:00 UTC. Canary region: eu-west-1. Watch telemetry and error-rate gates.

sophia: ack. i'll monitor traces + latency dashboards. setting alert for 3xx/5xx increase.

matt: can we pin model version for canary traffic? want to force v2.14.0-model-a on cohorts until 20% step finishes.

sophia: yes — pinning now. command: `deploybot pin --release v2.14.0 --cohort canary --model v2.14.0-model-a`

install shows: `deploy-bot: pin accepted — cohort=canary model=v2.14.0-model-a`

anna: what's our rollback plan if token latency spikes > 30% or error rate +0.5pp?

kai: rollback decision matrix: if latency > 25% for >5m OR p95 token latency > 1s increase AND errors >0.5pp, we pull flag back to 0% and trigger immediate rollback for pinned model. Steps: 1) flip flag to 0% 2) run `deploybot rollback --release v2.14.0 --force` 3) notify infra oncall.

ops-runner: noted. I'll keep a terminal ready. Also enabling temporary extra logging for affected route: `REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL=debug` for 30m.

matt: can we do a soft holdpoint at 5%? i.e., auto-pause ramp and require manual ack to continue.

sophia: yes — adding holdpoint: `deploybot hold --release v2.14.0 --at 5% --manual-continue` -> done.

deploy-bot: Holdpoint added at 5%. Ramp will pause and wait for `deploybot continue --release v2.14.0` or manual override.

(some minutes later)
sophia: telemetry looks stable at 1% (no p95 delta, errors flat). continuing to 5%.

matt: continuing now. running `deploybot continue --release v2.14.0`

deploy-bot: Continuing ramp to next step (5% -> 20%). Estimated time to reach 20%: ~22m.

anna: FYI, QA noticed a slight semantic change in reranker results at 20% in canary — not production breaking but worth tracking. opening an evaluation ticket.

kai: good catch. set a regression alert tied to the eval prompt set — if quality score drops > 2 points, pause.

(some later)
sophia: we hit 20% and telemetry still green. moving to 50% in 30m.

ops-runner: prepping rollback if needed. infra oncall @morgan is on standby.

matt: one more safety: enable temporary circuit-breaker on route `/v1/generate` to 100 concurrent requests for flagged traffic. command: `deploybot set-qos --route /v1/generate --limit 100 --cohort flagged`

deploy-bot: QoS limit applied.

(sometime after)
sophia: at 50% — minor bump in p95 but below thresholds; QA ticket shows non-blocking divergence. recommend full enable tonight.

anna: agree. let's schedule full enable at 23:00 UTC with a shorter 30m soak. I'll draft release note bullet about observed reranker divergence and link ticket.

matt: thanks all. closing thread unless anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
